# Jorden Lacy Jackson

> Solarpunk artist, creative technologist, worldbuilder and writer based in Los Angeles. Creator of Solarpunk Sandbox and founder of Old Ink Records.

Jorden Lacy Jackson treats solarpunk as a lifestyle, a mindset and inner work. Her central idea: we are at a threshold, living between worlds, and it is up to us to build the bridge between the old world and the new. Solarpunk Sandbox (solarpunksandbox.com, youtube.com/@jordenlacyjackson) is the future half of her work. The Solarpunk Scriptorium at Old Ink Records (solarpunkscriptorium.com, oldinkrecords.com) is the past half: Histories, Mysteries and Comedies.
